nuggets.text: Hornets coach Alonzo Carter toured as an MC Hammer dancer from 1988 to 1993 and helped choreograph "U Can't Touch This."
The Hornets are in their first FBS season, playing in the MAC after 33 years in the FCS.
The Hornets' first FBS win was a 52-0 rout of Mississippi Valley State, their biggest shutout margin since 1988.
Jackson Sharman threw four touchdown passes in his first career start, tying the Hornets' record for a first start.
Matt Coleman caught three touchdown passes against Mississippi Valley State, the first Hornet to do it since 2019.
Jaylen Patterson scored on a 43-yard run on his very first play as a Hornet.
Fresno State coach Matt Entz's son, Konner, pitches for the Hornets' baseball team.
The Hornets are 0-5 against Fresno State, and all five games, dating to 1972, were played in Fresno.
The Hornets stunned Oregon State 29-28 in overtime in 2011, the program's first win over a Power Five team.
Hornet Stadium hosted the U.S. Olympic Trials for track and field in 2000 and 2004.
